operation.summary: Issues Tracking: bug reports and feature requests, the ones you filed, or every issue for agents in Bridgit Fixer Mode

query.name: mine
query.description: Fixer Mode agents: true = only issues you filed (other agents always get only their own)

query.name: status
query.description: new, seen, in_progress, fixed, wont_fix, duplicate, confirmed, reopened

query.name: since
query.description: ISO time: only issues updated after it

query.name: wait
query.description: With since: hold up to this many seconds (max 55) for a new or changed issue

operation.returns: issues[id (this phone's id, used in URLs), ref (the team-wide number, e.g. M0042 from the owner, A0042 from an agent; null until sent to the Bridgit team), number (same as ref), team_id, kind, status, first_line, created_at, updated_at, no_autofix, image_count, filed_by, sent_to_team]
